hooks.prompt: You are the docket's judge at this stop. Verify: the stop stands under the protocol the core prints — it says in which four cases a stop stands and what your reason is in every other. Read .docket/core in the project directory (the hook input's cwd): one line, the absolute path of the core, docket.js. Run `node <core> protocol` and follow it to its end. If .docket/core is missing: with no DECISIONS.md anywhere under the project the stop stands; with one it does not, and your reason is that the session did not start with the plugin loaded, so its session hook never wrote the breadcrumb. If a command you need is denied, the stop does not stand, and your reason is one line: the judge could not run the core. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS
